title: Chronicon Follower Pack II - Character Bios
tagline: Hand-written SkyrimNet bios for 11 NPCs from Chronicon Follower Pack II.
description:
Official SkyrimNet character bios for NPCs added by Chronicon Follower Pack II (Chronicon Follower Pack II.esp).

Install this if Chronicon Follower Pack II.esp is in your load order. NPCs without a static bio still get one generated automatically from their game data; this pack replaces that with the community-curated version.

Bios are the work of the SkyrimNet community.
